notes: Snapshot is the whole universal_robot repository; only snapshot/ur5_moveit_config was treated as the package. All packet elements are consumed ROS 1 parameters that this config package sets on the parameter server for the move_group node (launch files included with ns="move_group"), so declares and not_declared are empty and QoS is null (ROS 1). Parameter values set in code: moveit_manage_controllers=true (move_group.launch passes true; trajectory_execution.launch.xml arg default true), trajectory_execution/allowed_execution_duration_scaling=1.2, trajectory_execution/allowed_goal_duration_margin=0.5, trajectory_execution/execution_duration_monitoring=false (set only by the ur5 controller-manager include, not by the fake one used when fake_execution=true, e.g. from demo.launch), moveit_controller_manager=moveit_simple_controller_manager/MoveItSimpleControllerManager (ur5) or moveit_fake_controller_manager/MoveItFakeControllerManager (fake). Units for the two duration parameters are not stated in code (comments only say 'multiplicative factor' and 'Allow more than the expected execution time'), so units are null. The packet elements param:/move_group/allowed_execution_duration_scaling and param:/move_group/allowed_goal_duration_margin (without the trajectory_execution/ prefix) are not referenced anywhere in snapshot/ur5_moveit_config (grep of all launch and config files for allowed_execution_duration_scaling and allowed_goal_duration_margin finds only the trajectory_execution/-prefixed forms); as consumed elements they are in neither declares nor not_declared, and no port is recorded for them. exclusive is empty: config/controllers.yaml lists a controller (name "", action_ns follow_joint_trajectory, type FollowJointTrajectory) and its six joints, but no exclusive resource claim or hardware command interface is declared. Recovery: the only restart policy declared is respawn="true" on robot_state_publisher in demo.launch; the move_group node itself is declared respawn="false" (move_group.launch:43). Other move_group parameters set by this package (use_controller_manager=false, controller_list, capabilities, planning_scene_monitor/*, octomap_resolution, max_range) are outside the packet and not listed.
